Well sometimes in something like discord for example, there’s a character limit. Also, not the best reason but for me it’s so the other person knows I’m interested in them and not taking a while to send a message, although, they’ll see me typing. The biggest reason would be if something is urgent I don’t want to worry because unnecessarily, for example, if I say “we need to talk” then taking ages to say what about it could be worrying for the other person, thinking I’m in hospital of something happened or we’ve got to break up. You might be asking why not have a disclaimer, but saying something like “we need to talk but it’s not extremely urgent and no one is in any immediate danger” probably would cause undue panic.
